Let me run a remote diagnostic on your router. Can you tell me the model number on the back of your device? Customer it says Model AC 1800. Agent, great. I am sending a reset signal to your device now. Can you unplug the router for 30 seconds and plug it back in? Customer OK. Done. It seems more stable now. Agent the diagnostic shows your connection is stable. If the issue returns within 48 hours, please call back and we will escalate to a technician. Customer sounds good. Thank you.
